# Explicit reviewed social business successor

This evidence is a later business change, not a re-recording of the original
presentation-only migration baselines. All original action inventories, protected
hashes, permission assertions and the independent six-path business successor
helper remain unchanged.

The three `.txt` files are exact original source bytes copied from the immutable
V33C checkpoint. Its independent full source manifest SHA-256 is
`28f996f090a8335506f37cda778692e60cdfb4205bb37e50654f585893084527`.
The exact reviewed successor hashes were verified against the frozen native
social review manifest, SHA-256
`f822d3376e70485e7e6d9040d41fd6de24f7475c64af8bb03ac25e64a82745f4`.
Neither old inventory hashes nor original evidence were generated from live
successor sources.

Only these production files are eligible:

- `src/ratings/discussion-controller.ts`: accept the exact non-authorizing
  `noticeRead=explicit` switch and suppress only the final automatic read.
  Existing owner target proof, notice ancestry, session fences and legacy notice
  behavior stay required.
- `src/pages/social-notices/controller.ts`: compose real like/save/follower
  readers; retain source-owned acknowledgments, exact session/safety lifecycle,
  privacy projection and truthful partial coverage while more pages or unknown
  coverage remain.
- `src/pages/social-notices/social-notices.ts`: inject the API client only when
  identity and community share the same session store. No other Page change.

The helper pins this manifest itself, its exact three-path allowlist, independent
baseline/review hashes, exact original evidence location and bytes, and exact
reviewed live bytes. It accepts only the explicit `src/...`, `apps/wechat/src/...`
and source-relative aliases of these three filenames. It never normalizes paths,
permits traversal or accepts unknown files/historical hashes. Rejected entries
continue through each historical test's original strict hash assertion.

The dedicated guard tests verify scope/provenance, immutable prior inventories,
negative hash/path/evidence/current-byte cases, exact limited rating/Page source
changes, legacy-versus-explicit rating behavior and real follower pagination and
safety invalidation. Source-only social tests provide the broader privacy,
transport, lifecycle, ancestry and explicit-read regression coverage. Historical
presentation/action tests still run unchanged apart from importing and invoking
this narrow guard before their original assertions.

Future production changes need a separate explicit review; do not regenerate this
manifest or these originals to make a failing guard pass.
